deadline.value: The physics doctoral page gives no application deadline; it only refers to the Faculty of Science doctoral rules.

gre_subject.value: No Physics GRE Subject requirement is stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: The application for acceptance must include a signed supervision agreement, so a supervisor must be agreed before admission.
supervisor.quote: Please be aware that incomplete applications cannot be processed | the filled out supervision agreement

also.quote: The first step is to find a supervisor at the University of Tuebingen

funding.value: Candidates must organise their own funding; positions or scholarships exist only in some programmes, so funding is competitive, not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Doctoral candidates are responsible for organizing their own funding. | Doctoral programs can offer positions or scholarships, but this does not apply to all programs.

entry_route.value: The physics doctoral page does not state the entry degree; it refers to the Faculty of Science doctoral rules.
